assumptions: One organization, immutable two-unit credit quote, one Session and PaymentIntent, two provider create calls and two refund amounts.
Transactions and receipt publication are atomic. Provider idempotency is assumed within the original retained window; the separate clock model does not establish compositional refinement.
Cryptography, arbitrary decimals, SQL isolation, unbounded provider/network delay and TypeScript refinement are not proved.
bounds.progress: No fairness or temporal progress claim. Safety covers only the declared finite model.
bounds.conformance: The hook requires every named real PGlite route/service/migration scenario for this model. Authentication and remote Stripe are controlled boundaries in the existing tests. General trace equivalence, provider behavior and composition of the two models are not proved.
